From 462354d986b6a89c6449b85f17aaacf44e455216 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Giovanni Cabiddu <giovanni.cabiddu@intel.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2021 21:21:10 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] crypto: qat - use proper type for vf_mask

Replace vf_mask type with unsigned long to avoid a stack-out-of-bound.

This is to fix the following warning reported by KASAN the first time
adf_msix_isr_ae() gets called.

    [  692.091987] BUG: KASAN: stack-out-of-bounds in find_first_bit+0x28/0x50
    [  692.092017] Read of size 8 at addr ffff88afdf789e60 by task swapper/32/0
    [  692.092076] Call Trace:
    [  692.092089]  <IRQ>
    [  692.092101]  dump_stack+0x9c/0xcf
    [  692.092132]  print_address_description.constprop.0+0x18/0x130
    [  692.092164]  ? find_first_bit+0x28/0x50
    [  692.092185]  kasan_report.cold+0x7f/0x111
    [  692.092213]  ? static_obj+0x10/0x80
    [  692.092234]  ? find_first_bit+0x28/0x50
    [  692.092262]  find_first_bit+0x28/0x50
    [  692.092288]  adf_msix_isr_ae+0x16e/0x230 [intel_qat]

Fixes: ed8ccaef52fa ("crypto: qat - Add support for SRIOV")
Signed-off-by: Giovanni Cabiddu <giovanni.cabiddu@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Marco Chiappero <marco.chiappero@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Fiona Trahe <fiona.trahe@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

diff --git a/drivers/crypto/qat/qat_common/adf_isr.c b/drivers/crypto/qat/qat_common/adf_isr.c
index e3ad5587be49..daab02011717 100644
--- a/drivers/crypto/qat/qat_common/adf_isr.c
+++ b/drivers/crypto/qat/qat_common/adf_isr.c
@@ -15,6 +15,8 @@
 #include "adf_transport_access_macros.h"
 #include "adf_transport_internal.h"
 
+#define ADF_MAX_NUM_VFS	32
+
 static int adf_enable_msix(struct adf_accel_dev *accel_dev)
 {
 	struct adf_accel_pci *pci_dev_info = &accel_dev->accel_pci_dev;
@@ -72,7 +74,7 @@ static irqreturn_t adf_msix_isr_ae(int irq, void *dev_ptr)
 		struct adf_bar *pmisc =
 			&GET_BARS(accel_dev)[hw_data->get_misc_bar_id(hw_data)];
 		void __iomem *pmisc_bar_addr = pmisc->virt_addr;
-		u32 vf_mask;
+		unsigned long vf_mask;
 
 		/* Get the interrupt sources triggered by VFs */
 		vf_mask = ((ADF_CSR_RD(pmisc_bar_addr, ADF_ERRSOU5) &
@@ -93,8 +95,7 @@ static irqreturn_t adf_msix_isr_ae(int irq, void *dev_ptr)
 			 * unless the VF is malicious and is attempting to
 			 * flood the host OS with VF2PF interrupts.
 			 */
-			for_each_set_bit(i, (const unsigned long *)&vf_mask,
-					 (sizeof(vf_mask) * BITS_PER_BYTE)) {
+			for_each_set_bit(i, &vf_mask, ADF_MAX_NUM_VFS) {
 				vf_info = accel_dev->pf.vf_info + i;
 
 				if (!__ratelimit(&vf_info->vf2pf_ratelimit)) {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/crypto/qat/qat_common/adf_isr.c`**
   - Added a new macro definition: `#define ADF_MAX_NUM_VFS 32`.
   - Changed the type of the variable `vf_mask` from `u32` to `unsigned long` to prevent stack out-of-bounds issues.
   - Updated the `for_each_set_bit` loop to use `ADF_MAX_NUM_VFS` instead of calculating the size of `vf_mask` for the loop iteration.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in the file are directly related to addressing a bug reported by KASAN regarding stack out-of-bounds access. By changing the type of `vf_mask` to `unsigned long`, the patch ensures that the variable can accommodate larger values without causing stack overflow. The introduction of the `ADF_MAX_NUM_VFS` macro provides a clear and maintainable way to define the maximum number of virtual functions (VFs) that can be processed, enhancing the readability and safety of the loop that iterates over the bits in `vf_mask`. Overall, these changes work together to fix the bug while improving code clarity and safety.
